Full stack developer with hands-on experience in Angular and Node.js. Comfortable with backend REST API

•
Implemented role-based dashboards for students, wardens, and admin staff
Inventory Management Tool
•
Node.js/Express REST API with MySQL, basic Angular frontend for CRUD operations
CERTIFICATIONS
